text:
Maya (partnerships): Heads up - GCP Marketplace asked for our compliance artifacts: SOC2 cover note, pen-test status, and downloadable evidence links. They want presigned links. Deadline next Fri per their PM. Who can own what?

Kevin (security): I can own SOC2 cover note and attach most recent vuln scan exports. We don't have a fresh external pentest this quarter, so we should include our internal scanning and a booked external pentest window.

Anna (legal): I can sign a short attestation. Please include scope (prod envs only), timeframe (last 12 months), and statement about third-party test schedule. Avoid promising remediation timelines in the attestation.

Olivia (partner-eng): Proposal: create a single evidence bucket `redwood-marketplace-artifacts`, upload redacted PDFs/CSV, and provide presigned links with 7d expiry. I'll maintain an index.csv with filename, owner, redaction notes.

Sam (cloudops): I'll provision the bucket and a temporary upload role. Command I'll use for presigns: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/<file> --expires-in 604800`. Will set bucket policy to deny public access and enable server-side encryption.

Maya (partnerships): Sounds good. Owners: Kevin = SOC2 + scan exports + pentest schedule; Olivia = artifact redaction + index; Sam = infra + presigns; Anna = sign-off. Please ack. :white_check_mark:

Kevin (security): Ack. Quick note: internal scans include Qualys/Nessus and container image scans (Trivy). I'll include summary CSVs and full JSON exports. We'll redact hostnames/IPs and AWS account IDs.

Olivia (partner-eng): On redaction - plan is to remove IPs and replace with placeholders like `<redacted-ip>`, strip AWS account IDs, and remove internal-only comments. I'll include a README.txt explaining redactions.

Anna (legal): Also include a contact email and point of contact in README for any follow-ups from Marketplace.

ci-bot: checklist created: https://internal.redwood.dev/marketplace/checklists/evidence-upload (automated note) :robot_face:

Sam (cloudops): I'll apply lifecycle rule to auto-delete uploads after 14 days and tag objects `marketplace:evidence=true`. Temporary role will expire in 48h.

Kevin (security): Draft SOC2 cover note uploaded: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xYzExample. Includes scope, assertion, list of attached artifacts, and pentest vendor + date window. Anna pls review.

Anna (legal): Reviewing now. If wording is standard I can sign today. Will not add contractual commitments beyond what Marketplace requested.

Maya (partnerships): Timeline recap: Kevin to finalize doc + scan exports today, Olivia to upload redacted artifacts and index tomorrow AM, Sam to post presigned links once uploaded, Anna to sign cover note when ready, Maya to reply to PM with links and pentest schedule by Friday COB.

Olivia (partner-eng): Upload plan: I'll upload in batches and post the index; files will be named with short descriptors and a version tag, e.g., `nessus-export-v1.json`, `soc2-excerpt-2025-04.pdf`.

Kevin (security): One more thing - marketplace may ask for evidence of remediation for high CVEs. I'll flag any critical/high items and include remediation notes in the index.

Sam (cloudops): Temp role created: `marketplace-evidence-uploader-2025-04`. I'll DM creds to Olivia and Kevin.

Maya (partnerships): Perfect. Please react to this thread when your item is done so I can close the loop. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
